step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture shows Skyscanner's Kubernetes cluster autoscaling mechanism using 100% EC2 Spot instances across multiple Auto Scaling Groups (ASGs). The Kubernetes Cluster Autoscaler (K8S CA) acts as a control entity, dynamically adjusting the desired instance capacity of multiple ASGs (ASG 1 and ASG 2) to maintain capacity and diversify across instance types and availability zones.

graph.name: Skyscanner Kubernetes Cluster Autoscaling on 100% Spot Instances
graph.notes: Skyscanner operates Kubernetes clusters fully on Spot instances using multiple Auto Scaling Groups to diversify across instance types (C3, C4, C5, M4, R3) and AZs. The Kubernetes Cluster Autoscaler dynamically updates ASG desired counts to scale capacity.
